about.title: About Me
about.journeyDesc1: Developers with strong motivation to grow in the tech industry.
about.journeyDesc2: I am 25 years old and based in Dondou Village, Hadsayfong District, Nakhonluang Province. I graduated with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from the National University of Laos in 2021.
about.whatIDoDesc1: I specialize in full-stack development, cloud architecture, and DevOps practices. I'm experienced in building microservices, implementing CI/CD pipelines, and optimizing application performance.
about.whatIDoDesc2: Passionate about software development, continuous learning, and creating efficient solutions.

items.title: Full Stack Developer
items.description:
- Design custom documents, such as flowcharts, sequence diagrams, etc. Most of the work is done in Japan, and the application is customizable. Plugins work in the Kintone app.
- Write code, review code, and create documents related to unit and integration testing.
- Connect with ChatGPT to help analyze problems and provide solutions.
- Connect with Google Translate for translation from English to Japanese.
- Sendgrid for emails, with customizable content.
- Collaborate on various projects with Systory partner companies.
